purpose: Make meaningful geographic features the source of world shape so terrain, cliffs, materials, streaming chunks, Home Estate instances, and future endless worlds share one deterministic world authority without raw-noise contour topology.

geography.currentFeatureGrammar: deterministic overlapping rotated plateau ellipses on a global macro lattice
geography.cliffMeaning: derived boundary where neighboring structural levels differ
geography.forestFeatureGrammar: deterministic rotated forest-grove ellipses with feathered edges and optional coherent meadow clearings
geography.continentalTopologySource: deterministic overlapping multi-lobe continental features plus continuous multi-scale coastline displacement
geography.starterMainlandGrammar: six overlapping broad continental lobes anchored to the Willowmere southern coast; no single giant ellipse owns the silhouette
geography.macroContinentGrammar: one primary rotated ellipse plus three overlapping directional lobes per enabled 3072-tile macro cell
geography.coastlineDisplacement: three continuous global-coordinate bands at broad, medium, and detail scales; no per-chunk coastline noise

terrainMaterialRules.mountainPathOwner: explicit traversal connector or authored road/path only
terrainMaterialRules.dirtOwner: meaningful authored/geographic contexts such as roads, clearings, disturbed ground, banks, farming, and future feature recipes
terrainMaterialRules.forestPopulationOwner: bounded geographic forest habitat; density feathers from grove core to woodland edge and leaves open meadows/clearings

streaming.futureEndlessWorldRule: generate deterministic geographic regions from world seed plus region coordinate; chunks remain storage/residency units cut from that geography

homeEstateCompatibility.futureExpansionRule: owned parcel mask determines playable area; derived decorative border is regenerated only on changed perimeter
